All address-only behavior is attached to class members, the main/result/round/card/player PMF tables are typed, the 0x270 shared state has compiler-owned destruction, and the scene/card/player/cursor layout is explicit.

Semantic placement construction is unavailable in this compiler setup, so the literal classInit bridge preserves allocation size, base construction, vptr transitions, Particle::SysTracker construction and shared-state construction explicitly and byte-exact.

FACTORY RELOCATION PROOF: the TU-local _ZTV14dScMgMemory2_c reference uses the ABI two-word preamble (+8); objisolate rebases it to the ROM slot-array convention. This makes focused verification genuinely 52/52 with clean relocation destinations, rather than relying on a same-object exception.

CURRENT NON-TEXT BOUNDARY: this promotion owns the complete contiguous .text run only. The PMF tables, resource/static data, compiler-generated RTTI/vtable, __sinit_ov006_021314e4 and 0x021423a8..0x02142490 BSS remain ROM-gap owned until their exact input-section order and initializers are reconstructed.

PROMOTED to src/actors/dScMgMemory2_c.cpp. The whole 52-function run moves as one unit -- no subset was taken: the cartridge orders D1 (0x020f5564) BELOW D0 (0x020f55b8), the reproducible direction, and delinks.txt carries no coverage hole across 0x020f5564..0x020f7634, so nothing forces a cut. Placement follows notes/agents/roles/writer.md's fixed convention (src/actors/<Class>.cpp) and the same-overlay pipeline precedent src/actors/dScMgD3DBase_c.cpp, superseding the pre-promotion plan's src/minigames/d_s_mg_memory2.cpp; the thirteen sibling d_s_mg_*.cpp files predate that convention.

COMPILER-ONLY ROW COUNT IS 13 DATA + 1 FUNCTION, DERIVED not copied. dScMgMemory2_c -> dScMgSingle3DBase_c -> dScMgBase_c -> dScene_c -> dBase_c -> fBase_c is SIX levels, so 2 x 6 typeinfo rows + 1 vtable = 13, with no Vector3 term (the class has no Vector3 member and no member's locals odr-use one). The queue row's compiler-only:~11 estimate was copied from sibling_oracle dScMgSingle3DBase_c, which sits one level shallower (2 x 5 + 1 = 11); the estimate is short by exactly the two rows this class's own extra ancestry adds. The 14th row is _ZN14dScMgMemory2_cD2Ev, a genuinely homeless base-object destructor -- plain deadstrip.

EMISSION ORDER WITHOUT REVERSING THE SOURCE. This TU is written ROM-ASCENDING and still emits ROM-ascending, because `#pragma defer_codegen off` (line 230, after the includes and the extern block) makes mwccarm 2004/b56 emit each definition as it is encountered instead of deferring and reversing. That is what keeps the two file-local optimisation pragmas -- opt_propagation off around DrawCards and opt_loop_invariants off around ResultFinish, each bracketed #pragma push/pop -- attached to the members that measured them, and it is why the out-of-line destructor here yields licensed D1-then-D0 rather than the D2/D0/D1 the deferred path gives.
